primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The SGUS is a combination of the scores of the 4 salivary glands (2 parotid and 2 submandibular) each gland is scored on a 5-point scale (0 to 4; 4 being more severe), with the maximum total score being 16.

groups.description: parsaclisib was administered orally once a day for up to 12 weeks.
groups.title: Parsaclisib

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Full analysis set included all participants enrolled in the study who received at least 1 dose of study drug.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Proportion of Participants With a 1 Point or Greater Change on the Salivary Gland Ultrasound (SGUS) Score for Parotid and Submandibular Glands
